Name: Elstrakin, the Tailmother
Information:
**Elstrakin, the Tailmother**

The prophet of Luxus and voice of Kitsune is a powerful archdruid who draws upon the wisdom of one mother, and the flames of the other. She is the embodiment of the Singeing itself, and has protected herself with rituals meant to prevent her from being preyed upon by Nogistune. Elstrakin is hailed as the spiritual leader of all kits’adria, and who, through divine knowledge, knows each who walks Somnus Domina. She guides her family, cares for the Deep Pause Temple, and fights back against the tyranny of her fallen siblings.

**Born of Flame**

As of her last Singeing, Kitsune and Elstrakin wove the very nature of the Singeing into Elstrakin so that if her life would end, she would be empowered by the same flames that have consumed each member of the First to Skulk to allow their rebirth. It serves as a reprisal of energy, a defensive countermeasure, a means to access unthinkable magic, and finally it is a way to prevent her body and soul from falling into the hands of her sister, should she perish. Thanks to this, Elstrakin has come to embody the fires of rebirth, and is seen as a symbol of flame’s ability to reinvigorate the very land it burns.

**Hidden Names**

Though she tends to her duties as the Tailmother, Elstrakin commonly disguises herself and takes on different identities so she can investigate matters related to other kits’adria, and will secretly serve many roles within her own community.

traits.name: Before I Burn Out (Mythic Awakening)
traits.description:
Elstrakin is reduced to 0 hit points or is killed outright, her hit points instead reset to 120, she regains her spent Legendary Reactions, ends any effects on her causing unwanted conditions, and can use her Mythic Traits and Mythic Actions for 1 hour.

Additionally, when her Mythic Awakening is triggered, she can immediately cast nova using her Spellcasting trait, requiring no action.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description: Elstrakin is a 16th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom. She has the following spells prepared:
traits.notes: Elstrakin will not use her 6th-level or higher spells or spell slots, unless her Mythic Awakening has triggered.

traits.name: Wild Caster
traits.description: Elstrakin does not require verbal or material components for her druid spells, and can cast them while in fox form.

traits.name: Wildspeaker
traits.description: Elstrakin is perpetually under the effects of speak with animals and speak with plants.

traits.name: Mythic: Pyrewalk Contingent
traits.description: Elstrakin’s body is wreathed in divine flames, giving her immunity to fire damage, and all of her attacks deal an additional 9 (2d8) fire damage. Any creature who hits her with an attack from within 15 feet takes a d10 of fire damage. If Elstrakin is killed, her body immediately vaporizes into ash, leaving behind magical possessions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Elstrakin makes two weapon attacks, one of which she may replace with casting a spell with a casting time of 1 action. Elstrakin may use her Wisdom in place of Strength or Dexterity for weapon attacks.

actions.name: Quarterstaff of Purifying Fire
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (1d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 5 (1d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Mythic: Singeing Root
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 21 Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are restrained until the start of Elstrakin’s next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.description: Elstrakin turns into a small fox, or back into her true form, while retaining her statistics in either form. If she is reduced to 0 hit points, she returns to her true form. Her equipment merges into her when she becomes a small fox.

reactions.name: Mythic: Tree Dodge
reactions.description: When an attack hits Elstrakin, she can force her attacker to make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, she teleports up to 30 feet away to an unoccupied space, leaving behind a husk made of tree bark resembling her body, which takes the attack for her and leaves her unharmed. The attacker still takes damage from Pyrewalk Contingent as though they had hit her.
